ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism shown in the image is an herbivore?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a coastal food web diagram titled “COASTAL FOOD WEB”. The diagram is labeled with organisms such as algae, plankton, soft-shell clam, blue crab, horseshoe crab and eggs, menhaden, striped bass, etc. An arrow points from algae to soft-shell clam, indicating that soft-shell clam feeds on algae. Reasoning: The question asks which organism in the diagram is a herbivore. Herbivore refers to an animal that eats plants or plant-like producers; algae is a producer, and soft-shell clam eats algae, so soft-shell clam is the herbivore in the diagram.
